To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The use of solar absorption refrigeration systems can be an economical alternative to the use of electrically driven refrigerators in hot and sunny climates, especially in areas where there is a large difference in temperature between day and night.

the use of solar absorption chillers with double evaporator can be an effective means of reducing the cost of solar air conditioning in Morocco, and that the use of a thermal storage system in the hot water tank and the cold storage tank is a good solution for ensuring continuous cold production.

the use of solar thermal energy in the production of cold water for air conditioning is an efficient and environmentally friendly alternative to the use of conventional fossil fuels, especially in countries where the solar energy potential is high and the price of electricity and fossil fuels is high.
